comment: Parser-subject fixtures for the governed exit/fallback duration helpers. CSS time strings live here as DATA: the CRA-12 motion census polices SOURCE motion debt by design (SOURCE_EXTENSIONS excludes .json), and these strings are the parser's input corpus, not motion authored into a component.

governedExit.name: returns the buffer alone when the element declares no motion
reads a seconds-unit animation duration as milliseconds
takes the longer of the two channels
takes the longest slot of a comma-separated list
treats a unitless entry as declaring no time

exitFallback.name: releases on the same tick when the channel declares nothing
sums duration and delay, then adds the grace
reads the transition channel when that is where the exit is declared
ignores the channel the exit is not declared on
wraps the shorter slot list the way CSS itself cycles it
